text:
arjun: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the 3/14 streaming incident. TL;DR: recurring pattern observed — handshake timeouts -> partial responses -> client reconnect storms. I want to lock ownership for remediation items and agree on timelines. Who can own what? Please ACK by EOD.

maria: I'll take item #2 (client reconnect backoff & jitter) — will sketch an RFC and a node-sdk POC by Wed.

ben: I'll take item #1 (server-side handshake timeouts) — will add targeted metrics and a brief hypothesis doc. ETA Tue COB.

kevin: I'll own item #3 (partial-response detection + auto-retry policy). I'll propose a spec tomorrow.

arjun: Owners now: #1 ben, #2 maria, #3 kevin. Items #4 (obs/dashboard) and #5 (load test infra) still open. I'll be the fallback owner for #4 until we assign.

ben: For #1 — initial hypothesis: kernel-level queue saturation under high connection churn. Action: add p95/p99 queue-depth and per-GPU connection count, and capture sample degraded connections. I'll push a small logging change and a reproducer script.

maria: For #2 — plan: SDK will get exponential backoff with capped jitter + client-side max-connections. Server will add a soft accept cap with graceful NACK. Will open RFC and POC.

kevin: For #3 — detection: emit a "partial_response" sentinel when stream ends without EOS; metric = stream.partial_rate. Auto-retry only for idempotent requests and when session-affinity is preserved. Spec will include edge cases for tool-calls.

arjun: Ops constraint: schedule canaries outside peak (09:00–17:00 PST). Target canary window 01:00–05:00 UTC. Agree?

ben: Agree on canary window. Rollback criteria: >0.5% increase in total error rate OR 2x baseline partial_rate in canary shard triggers immediate rollback.

kevin: Test plan: I'll build a harness that simulates client disconnects, truncated chunks, and socket resets. Need infra support to run at scale. Who can own infra work?

arjun: @maria can you coordinate eng-infra involvement and unblock the harness environment?

maria: Yep — I'll ping eng-infra, request quota for a 3-shard test, and loop them in this thread.

ci-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/stream-fix-v1 -> 3205010000, target shards: s1-s3 :rocket:

ben: I'll add dashboard tiles: "stream.handshake.timeouts" and "stream.partial.rate" and wire them into the incident playbook with alert thresholds. Will post links here.

arjun: Documentation/runbook: we need a short triage doc "How to investigate partial responses" for oncall. Kevin, can you draft?

kevin: Yes — after I finish the spec I'll draft the runbook and include example logs/queries.

maria: Proposed timeline: metrics+logs changes by Tue, SDK POC by Wed, canary Thurs (01:00–05:00 UTC), full rollout next week pending canary health.

arjun: I'll create a weekly recurring check-in to track progress and blockers. Next sync Friday 09:00 PT.

ben: ack.

kevin: ack.

maria: ack.

arjun: Closing notes: surface regression signals into Redwood Optimize (eval prompt set) so product can detect quality regressions from retries/quantization changes. I'll loop in product.

ci-bot: Reminder: Incident postmortem doc updated — https://redwood.internal/pm/streams-3-14 :memo:

ben: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
